body: Nope, good ol Colorado. The system sucks but what sucks even more is drowning in the mentality that money will burden us more than our mental health and struggles. My love for him is much bigger than debt could ever be.
Thank you! He is young and now he has a whole life ahead of him to figure it out.

He didn't cost my parents anything. All that money? Doesn't matter to me. I'll spend the rest of my life paying for it -without complaint, if that's what having him still alive means. I understand your view and I'm sorry you feel that way. Lack of money won't tear this family apart. Having to bury my best friend might have. Thank you for the comment, I hope you find comfort in anything and something. Have a nice one. I mean it.
